verdict.rationale: A default-enabled firewall is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a firewall, whether firewalld or any other. The defaults praised in the community items (zram, fstrim, systemd-oomd, systemd-resolved, btrfs) do not include one, and the privacy claim about data ownership is a different capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I get a default firewall enabled automatically without manual configuration
